title: Buddhist Mahayana Texts, incl. Heart Sutra (SBE 49)
author: Max Muller (trans)
description: A historical translation collection of Mahayana Buddhist scriptures in the Sacred Books of the East series. Including the Heart Sutra, it offers access to teachings on wisdom, emptiness and liberation within a nineteenth-century scholarly edition.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/buddhistmahy02cowe).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
